summary:
The Silent Atlas: Abandoned, But Not Forgotten

They were designed never to return, but not to be forgotten. The Silent Atlas is an interactive storytelling site about the NASA spacecraft humanity left behind. The Moon, Mars and deep space each get their own interactive map, covering 42 vehicles, from the Apollo landing sites and the Surveyor landers to Spirit, Opportunity and Voyager’s successors drifting beyond the planets. Each vehicle has a profile with its exact location, its mission, its final signal and a 3D model based on NASA data. The site explains why this hardware stays where it is: the cost of landing, deliberate sacrifice, silence and heritage. It ends with four proposals for remembering these machines responsibly.
details: The Silent Atlas is an interactive map of 42 NASA spacecraft left on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space. Each one has its location, its story and a 3D model. They were built never to return, but not to be forgotten.
